title: Final Energies
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the excitation energies of 2.3 MeV for 14N and 15.0 MeV for 12C.

title: Isospin Triplet Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the concept of isospin triplets and identify the members of the triplet for both nuclei.

title: Energy Difference Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive or reference the relationship between the energy differences of isospin multiplet members.

title: Coulomb Energy Role
description: Important Criteria: The student should discuss the role of Coulomb energy and neutron-proton mass difference in determining excitation energies.

title: Structure Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide insights into the structural differences of the nuclei that contribute to the energy differences.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all energy values are expressed in consistent units (MeV).

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in energy calculations or comparisons.
